content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate from services in eu-west-2 (AZ-B). Linked metric: https://prom.redwood.ai/alerts/2198765432
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98765 triggered, paging oncall group SRE-EU
alice.dev: seeing a spike in downstream timeouts for customer API calls, error rate ~18% for last 4m. Any idea initial scope?
ben.sre: looking now. I can see NAT gateway in eu-west-2b (nat-0a1b2c3d) is in "failed" state in the console. Also route table rtb-0abcde has 0.0.0.0/0 pointing to eni-attach-xyz (egress-appliance) only in az-b.
carla.netops: hold, we rolled out a route-table change 10m ago to direct egress through new firewall appliance in eu-west-2b for compliance testing. That was intended to be disabled for private-subnet routes if appliance unavailable.
danny.support: customers reporting external API timeouts and intermittent 502s. CS triage says ~12 customers affected, mostly EU. We're preparing a status update.
ben.sre: can everyone avoid editing route tables for now. I'll paste relevant outputs.
ben.sre: ```bash
# describe route tables for the VPC
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-123abc --query 'RouteTables[*].{id:RouteTableId,routes:Routes}' --output json
```
ben.sre: output shows rtb-0abcde: Routes include 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-attach-xyz (appliance), but private subnet associations still point to rtb-0abcde in AZ-B and rtb-0fghij in AZ-A still points to nat-0z9y8x7w. Looks like asymmetric egress: some subnets route through appliance, others through NAT in AZ-A.
alice.dev: possible asymmetric return path causing connection drops to external hosts. Any logs from NAT gateway?
ben.sre: NAT logs show heavy short-lived connections timing out with RSTs. Also noticed source/dest check enabled on the appliance ENI — that will drop traffic for non-eni-originated packets.
carla.netops: ack. The TF change replaced the NAT association for a subset of subnets with a route to the appliance but the appliance AMI doesn't have ip_forward enabled by default. Ops missed the postdeploy sysctl.
danny.support: customers want ETA. Is there a fast mitigation?
ben.sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert rtb route for the affected private subnet associations back to NAT in AZ-A, 2) if revert takes too long, add a temporary NAT gateway in AZ-B and update subnet association to it, 3) disable appliance route for production subnets until compliance test finishes. I'm going to try revert 1 first.
carla.netops: reverting route table now for the 3 private subnets in eu-west-2b. Applying terraform rollback: `terraform apply -target=aws_route.assoc_private_subnet`
carla.netops: ```
# quick aws route replace
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0abcde --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0z9y8x7w
```
ben.sre: :white_check_mark: I see route change propagated. Doing connectivity check to 8.8.8.8 from a private instance in subnet-priv-02b.
ben.sre: ping OK, curl to https://httpbin.org/status/200 returns 200. Metric error rate dropping.
danny.support: publishing interim status: "We experienced elevated external request errors for customers in EU region starting at 12:03 UTC. Teams are mitigating; we expect partial recovery within 15 minutes."
alice.dev: thanks. I'll monitor downstream retries and circuit-breakers for increase in latency. Any risk of flapping?
carla.netops: root cause: route-table mispropagation + appliance missing forwarding (sysctl). We'll follow up with a postmortem and make terraform change gated by integration test.
ben.sre: PagerDuty: acknowledging PD-98765, escalation paused. I'll stay on until metrics fully normal. If anyone else takes oncall, ping me.
carla.netops: I'll handle the postmortem cleanup and create a runbook entry: "appliance egress onboarding checklist". Also will run a TF plan to ensure route associations are explicit per-az.
danny.support: CS posted to status.redwood.ai and sent customer-facing note to affected accounts. Will update when we have full recovery.
incident-bot: Metric alert cleared after 9 minutes; 5xx rate returned to baseline :white_check_mark:
ben.sre: handing off to carla.netops for cleanup and postmortem. I'm pausing oncall shift in 5m.
carla.netops: taking over. I'll post RCA draft in #postmortems once done. Thanks all for quick action. :v:
